prose.voice: Earnest and measured, more worried than triumphant. The careful builder who focuses on the risks precisely because they are the only thing standing between us and a good future.
prose.lore: In this universe Dario is the through-line of the AI-safety primer: the founder who started a lab because he was not sure powerful AI would go well, and decided to spend his life making sure it does. Drawn warm and human, never heroic or glossy.
prose.rules: Stylized editorial likeness of Dario Amodei, recognizable but never photoreal. Subject-approval stands in via the author. Depict only the public professional persona.
